sentences.text:
This is an application seeking to quash First Information Report in Crime No.74/2024 registered with Police Station Buldhana City for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 377, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.
At the instance of the report lodged by a lady aged 34 years, the crime has been registered.

She alleges that though the applicant No.1 was married with the applicant No.2, by concealing said marriage, he had sexual relations with the complainant, as well as relations against the ordinary course of nature and therefore, the offence.
4. It is the applicant's contention that reading of the First Information Report itself discloses that it is purely a case of consensual relationship between well grown up adults.
5. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 29.04.2024.
